linear_rows_and_direct_reference_counts.scope_note: Counts are for parsed direct control references in the supplied bounded candidate spans.

details: The report contains the computed rows and counts but no parser source, command line for the full dumps, or parser implementation hash; exact parser reproducibility was therefore not established in this review.
The parser is evidently relying on objdump textual instruction mnemonics and printed semicolon target comments; direct target counts do not include register-indirect jumps or non-control references.

Linear disassembly may decode embedded data as instructions and does not discover alternate entry points; .word rows are unresolved and can encode instruction bits despite objdump directive formatting.
The four undecoded .word rows occur in the linear stream; any apparent branch target to 0x300440 is an objdump-decoded branch elsewhere, not semantics of a .word row.

limits: This verifies the report against the pinned package, record materializations, objdump text and tool hash, and audits bounded linear direct-reference counts.
No recursive control-flow completeness, embedded-program census, runtime selection/execution, canonical G1 admission, pseudocode completeness, source completeness or byte identity.
